description: Assignment 3 preparedness and practical reference evaluation

questions.question: Does elevation change how long I should boil clear water during an emergency?
questions.expected_snippet: Boil clear water for one minute at a rolling boil, or three minutes above 6,500 feet.

questions.question: Can heating or disinfecting a fuel-tainted water supply make it drinkable?
questions.expected_snippet: Boiling and disinfection cannot make water contaminated with fuel, toxic chemicals, or radioactive material safe.

questions.question: How far from openings should I operate a portable generator?
questions.expected_snippet: Run portable generators outdoors more than 20 feet from windows, doors, and vents.

questions.question: What kind of carbon monoxide alarm works during a blackout while using a generator?
questions.expected_snippet: use a battery-powered carbon monoxide detector or one with battery backup

questions.question: With the refrigerator unopened, how long will cold food keep during a power cut?
questions.expected_snippet: With the door closed, a refrigerator keeps food cold for about four hours.

questions.question: How does a full freezer compare with a partly filled one during a power outage?
questions.expected_snippet: With the door closed, a full freezer holds its temperature for about 48 hours and a half-full freezer for about 24 hours.

questions.question: What spare supplies should I pack with the flashlight in my emergency kit?
questions.expected_snippet: Pack a flashlight and extra batteries in the emergency supply kit.

questions.question: What kind of dressing should cover a clean open wound?
questions.expected_snippet: Cover a clean open wound with a waterproof bandage

questions.question: What electrical conversion lets household appliances use power from photovoltaic modules?
questions.expected_snippet: Solar modules produce direct-current (DC) electricity. A system uses power conversion equipment to turn DC into alternating current (AC) used by household appliances.

questions.question: When making a paper sheet by hand, what happens as the mold is lifted out of the pulp?
questions.expected_snippet: The screen held the fibers while water drained, forming a wet sheet.
